description: Accounts in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yūsuf. Three other pages of ʿArūs's accounts appear in the neighboring shelfmarks. Mentions pepper; tartar, brazilwood, and lac (in the entry at 90 degrees); "the ʿArīf purchased for me a ridda and [...] for Maḥfūẓ"; lac, sal ammoniac, and pepper; someone's brother in law.
description_he: חשבון בכתב ידו של עארוס בן יוסף; ארבעה עמודים
